snippet.title: Kings's Haven - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4050260/Kings_Haven/

Build your deck, expand your kingdom, and defend your Haven! Recruit Citizens, construct landmarks, and build powerful combos in this roguelike deckbuilder where each card is a Citizen and each season brings new rewards, new threats, and new choices.
